blocks.content: Grants 207.63 sq. km. critical mineral exploration block in Navatala-Devigarh to CMPDI.

items: Licence Area: Spans 207.63 sq. km. across Pachpadra tehsil (Balotra) and Shergarh tehsil (Jodhpur).
Awardee Entity: Central Mine Planning and Design Institute Limited (CMPDI).
Critical Minerals Identified: Lanthanum, Cerium, Praseodymium, and Neodymium for EV and semiconductor supply chains.
